about: Shared test vectors of the access core (docs/ACCESS.md). Generated from tests/access-vectors.src.mjs; copy byte for byte. Sections parse, normalize, resolve, resolveUser, pickByName, rootKey run in every runtime; selection, labels, compact, snapshot are JS only. Trees: { nodes: { id: { type, name } }, rels: [[from, to]] } -> makeTree. Id lists in expectations are sorted; sites are sorted by path (code-unit order), then id; unresolved in grant order, names last. A case without exists uses the tree nodes as the existing ids. has / hasAll / sees: id -> expected answer.
